role: wider Choice suite for zero-shot systems
claim: Fixed option lists, human labels, test splits that can be scored locally. Written before any system was scored on a dataset that is new here. Banking77 and MASSIVE reuse items that fine-tuned and zero-shot systems were already scored on.
subsample: prefix of a permutation from numpy SeedSequence(seed).spawn in seed_spawn_order; a split at or under its cap is used whole, in file order

banking77_full.source: full_banking77_protocol.json items; dev is the Program 1 Banking77 dev split

massive_en.source: primary_protocol.json items; dev is the whole official dev partition

clinc150.label: intent
clinc150.label_transform: replace underscore with space; the oos class is not an option
clinc150.out_of_scope: the 1000 oos test rows are kept as a separate split named oos. They have no correct option and are scored only for how much confidence a system places on them.

yahoo.text: question_title, a newline, then question_content; best_answer is not shown
yahoo.label: topic

not_included_yet.ai2_arc and mmlu: each item has its own option list; the Choice runners take one list per dataset
not_included_yet.financial_phrasebank: the hub copy is a loading script, which datasets 5.1.0 refuses
not_included_yet.llm_aggrefact: gated; no Hugging Face token on this machine

systems.jev: jev_protocol.json request and score rule; rows that return an error are requested again, up to 4 passes

qwen3-4b-index_prior.readout: readout_protocol.json prompt and score; the index_prior variant chosen there on Qwen3-0.6B dev is used as is and is not reselected for this model
qwen3-4b-index_prior.prior: mean index score per option over the dev inputs of the dataset; no label is used

gliclass-base-v3.0.added: 2026-10-08, before any GLiClass score on a dataset that is new in this suite
gliclass-base-v3.0.rule: the Program 1 GLiClass system unchanged: single-label softmax, float32, chunks of 25 labels
gliclass-base-v3.0.device: cpu for rows that are new here, because the GPU is held by decoder training; Banking77 and MASSIVE rows scored earlier on the GPU are reused
gliclass-base-v3.0.cpu_vs_gpu_check: the first 40 Banking77 test items are scored on the cpu and compared with the saved GPU scores; the largest difference and any argmax change are reported
gliclass-base-v3.0.latency: not timed on cpu; GPU latency on these datasets is a separate run

qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.added: 2026-10-10, before this model was scored on any suite item
qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.readout: identical to qwen3-4b-index_prior: readout_protocol.json prompt and score, zero-padded codes, the dev prior, no reselection. Only the model changes, so the two rows isolate the model generation.
qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.loaded_as: the text-only causal model (AutoModelForCausalLM); the vision encoder is not loaded
qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.prior: mean index score per option over the dev inputs of the dataset; no label is used
qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.why: Qwen3.5-4B is the model LLM2Jev (arXiv:2610.02076) reads, and it is rated well above Qwen3-4B. The Qwen3-4B suite results trailed LLM2Jev's published Banking77 number by about 20 points.
qwen3.5-4b-index_prior.latency_note: the optional causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention kernels are not installed, so transformers uses its slower reference implementation; latency from this run is not a fair speed figure for the model

qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.added: 2026-10-10, before this model was scored on any suite item; four made-up sentiment sentences were used to check that it loads and reads out
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.quantization: bitsandbytes 0.50.2, NF4 with double quantisation, bfloat16 compute; the output head stays bfloat16
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.quantization_note: At 16 bits this model needs about 19 GB and does not fit the 12 GB card. Results are for the 4-bit model and must not be read as the full-precision model's.
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.readout: identical to the other local Qwen rows: readout_protocol.json prompt and score, zero-padded codes, the dev prior, no reselection
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.loaded_as: the text-only causal model; the vision encoder is not loaded
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.prior: mean index score per option over the dev inputs of the dataset; no label is used
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.latency_note: as for qwen3.5-4b-index_prior, the optional fast kernels are not installed
qwen3.5-9b-4bit-index_prior.skip_note: Decided by the project owner on 2026-10-10, before this model had produced any CLINC150 score and before any of its test results were seen: at about 2 seconds per 77-option item, CLINC150 would take about 11 GPU hours. The model is scored on the other six datasets.

temperature: one scalar per system and dataset, fit on dev by the Program 1 rule
